|errata_history=This is a playtest image (2 December 2025), published before the set's official release (8 December 2025); the PC replaced it before release. The current text is [[Cloud City: Dining Room (V) (Errata)]] (PC-E1). Under Bill's ruling of 12 November 2026 pre-release images are Playtest versions; the original printing is [[Cloud City: Dining Room (V)]]. The image is the PC card image of this version.
* '''Playtest''' (this page): Playtest image: PC card image of 2 December 2025<ref name="ht-cc-0">PC card image in the PC's Holotable image set: [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/d7881b2/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual26-Dark/large/cloudcitydiningroom.gif cloudcitydiningroom.gif], commit [https://api.github.com/repos/swccgpc/holotable/git/commits/d7881b28d79e33541236559133b4d9583b43812d d7881b2] (2 December 2025).</ref>, no errata mark. The title strips print “•DINING ROOM” (top, Light Side) and “•DDINING ROOM” (bottom, Dark Side; doubled D). Text: “'''Light Side:''' Chewie, Han, Leia, and your Lando move to here using landspeed for free. '''Dark Side:''' Vader, your Boba Fett, and your Lando deploy -1 here. May deploy Lando here from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.”
* '''Original''' ([[Cloud City: Dining Room (V)]]): PC card image of 2 December 2025<ref name="ht-cc-1">PC card image in the PC's Holotable image set: [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/b65c961/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual26-Dark/large/cloudcitydiningroom.gif cloudcitydiningroom.gif], commit [https://api.github.com/repos/swccgpc/holotable/git/commits/b65c961784833ee85707666198a3d8bd794c032c b65c961] (2 December 2025).</ref>, no errata mark. What changed from the previous image: both title strips now print “•CLOUD CITY: DINING ROOM” (same day). Game text unchanged. Text: “'''Light Side:''' Chewie, Han, Leia, and your Lando move to here using landspeed for free. '''Dark Side:''' Vader, your Boba Fett, and your Lando deploy -1 here. May deploy Lando here from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.”
Versions follow Bill's ruling of 12 November 2026: every visible change on a PC card image is a version (the PC's own E marks count only its announced errata). 
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Cloud City: Dining Room (V) (Errata)]]): Slip on the Players Committee's Virtual Set 26 release sheet with errata (Set-26-Errata-Combined.pdf)<ref name="sheet26-20251226">Players Committee, [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-26-Errata-Combined.pdf Virtual Set 26 release sheet with errata] (PDF, 5 pages, footer “SWCCG Players Committee, December 2025”; file created 26 December 2025). Released with [[Virtual Set 26]] (8 December 2025); the PDF is dated by its creation date.</ref>, page 2, file created 26 December 2025: “'''Light Side:''' Chewie, Han, Leia, and your Lando move to here using landspeed for free. '''Dark Side:''' Vader, your Boba Fett, and your Lando deploy -1 here. May deploy Lando here from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.” '''What changed:''' Same words as [[Cloud City: Dining Room (V)]] (Original). The sheet reprints the PC card image of [[Cloud City: Dining Room (V)]] (published 2 December 2025) as a printable slip under the label “•Cloud City: Dining Room”, pixel for pixel the same except that the picture area is left blank (white), so the slip can be laid over the picture of the card named in its lower-left corner ([[Cloud City: Dining Room]]). A separate Players Committee publication, so its own version (Bill, 11 and 12 November 2026: every publication is a version; a release-sheet slip and the PC card image are separate printings). '''Errata mark:''' the slip prints no errata mark, but it is errata 1 in release order; recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 November 2026).
